characters.name: 陈海生
characters.design: 45-year-old male Yangtze ferry boatswain with tanned skin, stubbly white beard, wearing worn dark blue old uniform coat with rough work-worn texture and faint stains, dark work trousers and sturdy leather boots, calm steady expression, full-body front view, fits the gritty 1930s period night ferry atmosphere.

issues: 人物年龄明显偏大，呈现约60-70岁老年男性，与设计要点45岁不符；画面包含两名人物，设计要点描述为单一人物的全身正面视图

characters.name: 秀珍
characters.design: 42-year-old female with short gray-black bob hair, wearing dark blue cloth shirt and plain apron, holding a crumpled old handkerchief in her hand, plain cloth shoes, gentle worried expression, full-body front view, matches the desaturated celluloid film tone of the 1930s era.

props.name: 救生圈
props.design: Circular cork life rings covered with white canvas, lined up neatly on the wooden deck, slightly weathered with faint water stains, matte texture, warm kerosene light reflecting softly on the surface, mid-shot view to show the neat lined arrangement, fits the realistic period setting.

props.name: 煤油挂灯
props.design: Vintage 1930s kerosene hanging lantern with frosted glass shade, warm orange-yellow flickering flame, iron chain hanger, casting soft warm key light on the deck, slightly smoky glass, environmental view integrated with the deck scene, matches the noir-tinged atmospheric lighting.

scenes.name: 1937年冬江轮甲板夜景
scenes.design: Night scene of 1937 winter Yangtze night ferry wooden deck, worn textured wood planks, flickering warm kerosene lantern glow, lined life rings, wooden bollards with mooring ropes, distant shore lights blurred through river fog, desaturated cool blue-green base tone with lifted warm midtones, fine film grain, subtle rim lighting on figures, wide environmental shot, matches the gritty realistic period drama style.
